mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, full_name, password, enable, email_verified, is_deleted, plan, premium_activated_at, free_exams_used, role, created_at, updated_at FROM tbl_users WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND is_deleted = false

SELECT user_id, username, full_name, enable, email_verified, is_deleted, role, plan, premium_activated_at, free_exams_used, created_at, updated_at FROM tbl_users WHERE is_deleted = false ORDER BY user_id DESC

SELECT user_id, username, full_name, password, enable, email_verified, is_deleted, role, plan, premium_activated_at, free_exams_used, created_at, updated_at FROM tbl_users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_users WHERE username = 'admin'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_users (username, full_name, password, enable, email_verified, is_deleted, plan, premium_activated_at, free_exams_used, role, created_at, created_id, updated_at, updated_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{fullName}, #{password}, #{enable}, #{emailVerified}, #{isDeleted}, #{plan}, #{premiumActivatedAt}, #{freeExamsUsed}, #{role}, NOW(), #{username}, NOW(), #{username})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE tbl_users SET enable = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE tbl_users SET email_verified = #{verified}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE tbl_users SET plan = #{plan}, premium_activated_at = #{premiumActivatedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE tbl_users u SET u.plan = 'FREE', u.premium_activated_at = NULL, u.free_exams_used = GREATEST(u.free_exams_used, LEAST(#{limit}, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exams e WHERE e.owner_user_id = u.user_id ))), u.updated_at = NOW() WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = false

UPDATE tbl_users SET free_exams_used = free_exams_used + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND plan = 'FREE' AND enable = true AND email_verified = true AND is_deleted = false AND free_exams_used < #{limit}
UPDATE tbl_users SET free_exams_used = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE tbl_users u SET u.free_exams_used = LEAST(#{limit}, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exams e WHERE e.owner_user_id = u.user_id )) WHERE u.plan = 'FREE' AND u.free_exams_used = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exams e WHERE e.owner_user_id = u.user_id)
